description: Extends the org preset (github>hyperi-io/renovate-config) like every other DFE consumer. Local-only: ignoreDeps (clickhouse pinned to the fork via [patch.crates-io]; reqwest pinned <0.13 to match scalo, cel pinned <0.14 to match scalo because cel::Program crosses that boundary - both come off the list once scalo upgrades) and commitMessageAction lowercase (hyperi-ci commit-lint requires the description to start lowercase; renovate's default 'Update' fails it).
